risks.title: Client concentration and reliance on large clients
risks.summary: CI&T relies heavily on a limited number of large clients. Termination, scope reduction, or non-renewal of a major contract would significantly impact revenues and operating results. A typical risk for IT services firms with a concentrated client base.
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in the Risk Factors section (high priority), direct language ("If any of our largest clients terminates"), major financial impact on revenues, stable but structural risk in IT services business.

risks.title: Attracting and retaining highly skilled IT talent
risks.summary: CI&T operates in a highly competitive market for IT talent. Increased turnover would raise recruitment and training costs and reduce capacity to serve clients. Brazilian nearshoring exposes the company to global competition for qualified developers.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned twice in Risk Factors ("must attract and retain", "attrition"), urgent tone, direct impact on operating costs and growth capacity, critical for service-based model.

risks.title: Competitive intensity and technological innovation
risks.summary: CI&T faces intense competition from new entrants and established players. Rapid technological evolution (AI, cloud, data analytics) requires continuous innovation. Risk of service commoditization and margin pressure.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly stated ("We face intense competition"), moderate but repeated language, risk of market share and pricing power loss, context of rapid innovation (AI, cloud, ML mentioned).

risks.title: Solution quality and liability risks
risks.summary: Any degradation in software solution quality (bugs, failures, non-compliance) could cause client disruptions, reduce demand, and expose CI&T to civil liability claims.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk ("Degradation of the quality"), strong language ("disruptions", "liability"), impact on reputation and client retention, relevant for provider of customized software solutions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and client data compliance
risks.summary: CI&T must meet strict contractual obligations for client data security. Any cybersecurity incident (breach, attack) could lead to indemnification, client loss, and reputational damage. Operating in an environment of growing threats.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements ("risks related to cybersecurity and data privacy"), language of contractual obligation ("contractual security obligations"), risk of client indemnification, relevant for IT service provider.

risks.title: Dependence on IT services demand in limited sectors
risks.summary: CI&T's revenues are concentrated in a limited number of vertical sectors. Any decline in IT services demand in these sectors or inability to enter new markets would reduce growth and diversification.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited ("revenue is dependent on a limited number of industry verticals"), sector concentration risk, impact on growth if sectors decline, relevant for verticalized service model.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and economic instability in Brazil
risks.summary: CI&T is headquartered in Brazil and exposed to local political, economic, and regulatory risks (federal Supreme Court decisions, legislative changes). Brazilian macroeconomic instability could affect operations and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements ("uncertainty concerning the current economic, political, and social environment in Latin America, specifically in Brazil"), impact on operations and regulation, headquarters located in Brazil.

risks.title: Long sales cycles and significant investments
risks.summary: Some client projects involve long sales cycles with substantial human resource investments before revenue generation. Risk of non-realization or delays impacting cash flow and capacity utilization.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited ("long selling cycle"), impact on cash flow and resource allocation, moderate but structural risk in complex IT services model.

ai_positioning.summary: CI&T integrates AI responsibly into its digital transformation services, using it both as a lever for client innovation and as an internal tool to enhance ESG reporting quality. AI is positioned as an impact accelerator, not just a technology.
